annotations.title: 8-K filings, SEC material events: by company

description: Latest Form 8-K current reports for a US-listed company by ticker, name or CIK: filing date, the reported items with their meaning (results of operations, executive departures, material agreements, cybersecurity incidents, bankruptcy and others), accession number and a direct link, newest first. Public SEC EDGAR data. Use to watch a company's material events or check what it disclosed recently. Example: ticker=AAPL. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, e.g. 320193 (instead of ticker)

ticker.description: Stock ticker or company name, e.g. AAPL (or give cik)
